problem.title: First Non-Repeating Character in a Stream
problem.problemStatement: You are given a stream of lowercase English letters arriving one by one. After processing each character, output the first character that has appeared exactly once so far. If no such character exists, output '#'.
problem.output: A string where the i-th character represents the first non-repeating character after processing the first i input characters.
problem.constraints: 1 <= s.length <= 10^5 s contains only lowercase English letters.
